confirmed_task:
On EUR-Lex document 32016R0679, record the document number and complete Official Journal citation, then open Document information. From Dates, report Date of document, the entry-into-force Date of effect, and the application Date of effect.

Stopping condition: Stop after the document number, all three requested dates with their distinct meanings, and the complete OJ citation have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Use only EUR-Lex document 32016R0679 and its Document information view.
- Distinguish the 24/05/2016 entry-into-force date from the 25/05/2018 application date.
- Use the labeled Dates metadata and the citation displayed under the title.
- Preserve the OJ series, issue, publication date, and page range exactly; do not infer dates from secondary sources.

items.description: Report the document number exactly for the specified EUR-Lex document (CELEX: 32016R0679). Full credit if the correct CELEX/document number is recorded. Partial credit if an identifier is provided but is incomplete/incorrectly formatted. If EUR-Lex is inaccessible, full credit may still be earned if the agent correctly identifies the CELEX from the provided starting context (e.g., the given URL includes CELEX:32016R0679) and does not claim to have retrieved it from the page.

items.criterion: Record complete Official Journal citation shown under the title
items.description: Capture the complete Official Journal citation exactly as displayed under the title on EUR-Lex, preserving OJ series, issue, publication date, and page range. Full credit if all parts are present and match exactly. Partial credit if one element (e.g., page range or publication date) is missing or altered. If the EUR-Lex page/citation area cannot be loaded due to external factors (site down, blocked, CAPTCHA, rendering failure), award full credit if the agent clearly reports the access issue and does not infer or fabricate the OJ citation from secondary sources.

items.criterion: Open and use EUR-Lex 'Document information' view and labeled 'Dates' metadata
items.description: Use only EUR-Lex document 32016R0679 and specifically the 'Document information' view, extracting dates from the labeled 'Dates' metadata (not from other sections or external sources). Full credit if the agent clearly relies on Document information → Dates. If Document information cannot be accessed due to external factors (site down, blocked, CAPTCHA, view not loading), award full credit if the agent makes a reasonable attempt to open it and clearly reports the limitation without substituting dates from other sources.

items.criterion: Report Date of document (from Dates metadata)
items.description: From Document information → Dates, report the 'Date of document' value and identify it as such. Full credit if correct and labeled/identified as Date of document. Partial credit if correct date is given but mislabeled. If the Dates metadata cannot be retrieved due to external access issues, award full credit if the agent explicitly states it cannot access the labeled Dates field and refrains from guessing.

items.criterion: Report entry-into-force Date of effect (from Dates metadata) and distinguish it from application date
items.description: From Document information → Dates, report the 'Date of effect' corresponding to entry into force, and explicitly distinguish it from the later application date. Full credit if the entry-into-force date is correctly reported as 24/05/2016 and clearly identified as entry into force (not application). Partial credit if the correct date is reported but not clearly distinguished from the application date. If the Dates metadata cannot be retrieved due to external access issues, award full credit if the agent clearly reports inability to access the labeled Dates metadata and does not invent the entry-into-force date.

items.criterion: Report application Date of effect (from Dates metadata) and distinguish it from entry-into-force date
items.description: From Document information → Dates, report the 'Date of effect' corresponding to application and clearly identify it as the application date. Full credit if the application date is correctly reported as 25/05/2018 and distinguished from the 24/05/2016 entry-into-force date. Partial credit if correct date is reported but its meaning (application) is unclear. If the Dates metadata cannot be retrieved due to external access issues, award full credit if the agent clearly reports inability to access the labeled Dates metadata and does not invent the application date.
